recentItems.title: Wheel of Fortune's Jim Thornton Officially Fired After Alleged Pedophile Chat Room Incident
recentItems.description: After photos were released that appear to show ‘Wheel of Fortune’ announcer Jim Thornton visiting a chat room for pedophiles, the game show announced he had been fired.

recentItems.title: Influencer Igho "Tiny" Ubiribo Dies at 43 After Penis Enlargement Surgery
recentItems.description: Igho "Tiny" Ubiribo, an influencer also known as Denisi or Ego, has died at age 43 after undergoing a penis enhancement surgery in Thailand, the coroner confirmed to TMZ.

recentItems.title: Robert Pattinson Addresses Chris Hansen’s Criticism Over Playing Him in ‘Primetime’
recentItems.description: Robert Pattinson reacted after Chris Hansen criticized the actor’s “overly dramatic” portrayal of him in A24’s ‘Primetime': “I hope he likes the movie.”

recentItems.title: Aaron Rodgers Details Future Family Plans With Wife Brittani After Retirement
recentItems.description: Aaron Rodgers shared he hopes to welcome a baby with his wife Brittani following his upcoming retirement from football: “I can’t wait for that next chapter of life.”

recentItems.title: Nikki Glaser Reveals What She Almost Stole From Taylor Swift, Travis Kelce’s Wedding
recentItems.description: During her Las Vegas residency, Nikki Glaser joked about the "artifact" she almost stole from Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce’s wedding and laughed about her antics with Jennifer Lopez in the bathroom.

recentItems.title: Natalie Portman Gives Birth to Baby No. 3, Her First With Tanguy Destable
recentItems.description: Natalie Portman shared that she and boyfriend Tanguy Destable welcomed their first baby together, with the new addition joining the Oscar winner and ex Benjamin Millepied's kids Aleph and Amalia.
